verdict.rationale: Dover's first-party MCP server gives AI tools access to jobs, candidates, applications, and interview workflows, and Dover says users can "ask in plain English" while their AI client picks the right tool. Natural-language operation is therefore possible, but only through an external AI client; there is no evidence of a native in-app natural-language command interface. Missing for 10: a built-in natural-language command surface inside Dover, documentation of which write and edit actions can be run through plain-English commands, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask in plain English, and your AI client picks the right tool.
